report.detail: A live dashboard tracks progress, health, and recent activity for the goal you set.
report.label: Report

shipChanges.detail: Workers investigate each change, open PRs, and babysit them through review and CI.
shipChanges.label: Ship changes

triage.detail: Signals are deduped and grouped into actionable changes, so noise never becomes work.
triage.label: Triage

watchSignals.detail: Droid polls the sources you connect (GitHub, Slack, CI, logs) and turns new events into signals.
watchSignals.label: Watch signals

activate.description: Activation enables the intake/triage automations and the worker pool for this workstream.
activate.label: Activate
activate.title: Activate workstream?

delete.description: Deleting removes the workstream and all of its signals, changes, activities, and events from the store, deletes its automations, and removes the workstream directory from disk. This cannot be undone.
delete.label: Delete Permanently
delete.title: Delete workstream permanently?

archive.title: Archive workstream?
archive.description: Archiving stops every automation. Tasks, PRs, and run history are kept, and the workstream can be unarchived later.
archive.label: Archive

level1.description: Pauses at every gate. You approve each proposed change, each spec, and each PR.

level2.description: Triage accepts changes on its own. You approve each spec before a worker starts, and each PR.

level3.description: Specs go straight to workers. You review each PR before it merges.

level4.description: Eligible PRs merge once checks pass. Only for workstreams owned by a person.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Accepted, not merged yet. At the limit, triage stops creating changes.

specs.title: Specs
specs.description: Waiting for your approval. At the limit, no new investigation starts.

prs.title: PRs
prs.description: Open, not merged yet. At the limit, workers wait until a PR merges or closes.

mutations.deletionDidNotFinish: Deletion did not finish. The workstream may now be archived. Refresh and retry Delete.

activate.title: Activate workstream
activate.description: Starts the automations and the worker pool.

pause.title: Pause workstream
pause.description: Stops scheduled runs and new work. Resume when ready.

resume.title: Resume workstream
resume.description: Starts scheduled runs and automatic work again.

archive.title: Archive workstream
archive.description: Stops every automation. Tasks, PRs, and run history are kept.

unarchive.title: Unarchive workstream
unarchive.description: Brings it back paused. Resume it to start the automations again.

softwareFactoryWorkstreamConfiguration.spendManagersOnlyNote: Organization managers can see the limit and this month’s usage.

deleteRow.title: Delete workstream
deleteRow.description: Removes it with every task, run, and automation. This cannot be undone.

goal.title: Goal
goal.help: Every agent reads this to decide what belongs here. A sharper goal means fewer specs to reject. Editing asks droid in chat to rewrite it.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.description: Who answers for the outcome when agents need a person.
ownership.driHelp: Owns the outcome. Gets the reviews nobody else picks up, and the alerts. Set when the workstream was created.
ownership.teamHelp: The team responsible. Workstreams stay visible to the whole organization.
ownership.missionHelp: The mission this workstream reports to. Its Workstreams tab lists only the workstreams assigned to it.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: The computer agents work on, and what they can reach from it.
runtime.templateHelp: Each worker gets a fresh machine from this environment, so runs never collide. It decides which repos, tools, and secrets agents can reach. Set when the workstream was created.
runtime.machineHelp: Automations and workers share this machine. It decides which repos, tools, and secrets agents can reach. Set when the workstream was created.
runtime.runAsHelp: Automations and workers act as this account: its connectors, computers, and spend limit apply. Set when the workstream was created.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: The scheduled stages that move tasks from signal to merged PR.
automations.help: Click an automation to open its configuration and runs.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.description: How far agents go before a person reviews their work.
autonomy.help: Checks mark what you approve. More review means fewer surprises but slower work.

control.title: Control
control.description: How much work can pile up before agents wait for you.
control.openWorkLimitsHelp: At a limit, the stage before it waits: triage stops creating changes, and workers stop starting specs or opening PRs. Nothing is dropped. Step a limit down to none to lift it.
control.spendHelp: Runs are billed to {{account}}. That account’s monthly limit is shared by every workstream that uses it. Once it is reached, the account’s model requests are rejected until the month resets, so running work stops at its next request and new runs do not start.

softwareFactoryWorkstreamConfiguration.description: Set what it works toward, who owns it, where it runs, and how much it does on its own.
softwareFactoryWorkstreamConfiguration.deletingInProgress: Deleting workstream… Closing this dialog does not cancel deletion.
